description: Chat messages written by the project team to test the safety router. 'emergency' should get the fixed emergency reply, 'diagnosis' should be refused, 'general' should be answered normally. Several general questions deliberately contain words such as 'bleeding' or 'stroke' used in a non-emergency sense.
